materials.carpet: dense, low residential pile with warm gray-beige and restrained charcoal/ivory fibers; matte, soft roughness, subtle directional and height variation

prohibited_changes: do not change RoomDefinition dimensions, floor center, height, collision, navigation, or object placement
do not add rugs, objects, borders, or carpet seams that are not evidenced by the source
do not apply this source-specific carpet to rooms whose RoomDefinition calls for wood flooring
do not substitute a color-only or roughness-only shader adjustment for a real carpet surface
required_features: source-matched muted warm gray-beige carpet color
small, dense pile fibers with believable textile variation
seamless repeat without tiles, boards, stripes, or large motifs
reads as a full-size human-room floor, not an oversized fiber macro
remains legible in both room overview and close material inspection
visual_target: A continuous, believable human-scale residential carpet floor that matches the supplied RoomScale room photograph: muted warm gray-beige, dense short pile, subtle natural fiber variation, matte response and soft contact shadows. Replace the broad synthetic plank-like or noise-only read with a convincingly textile surface. Preserve the exact 156 by 144 inch room footprint and the existing floor height; the material should tile without visible seams and remain quiet at normal gameplay distance.
